title: Integer overflow, signedness pitfalls and safe arithmetic
learningObjectives: Explain the concept and its relevant rules.
Trace the example and justify its behaviour.
Identify important assumptions and failure cases.
Apply the concept in a reviewed and tested exercise.

understand.concept: Unsigned integer arithmetic wraps modulo the range size. Signed integer overflow is undefined when the mathematical result cannot be represented. Usual arithmetic conversions can also change signedness and width in mixed expressions.
understand.whyItMatters: Integer arithmetic defects can corrupt sizes, indexes, financial calculations and security checks. Defensive code validates ranges before performing operations.
understand.analogy: Treat standards, interfaces and release steps as explicit contracts that make assumptions visible.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy does not replace the C standard, implementation documentation or project-specific requirements.
